Gregor Hauffe (born 20 May 1982 in Magdeburg, East Germany) is a German former representative rower. He is a three time world champion and a dual Olympian. Hauffe competed at Beijing 2008 and London 2012 in the men's coxless four with both those crews making the Olympic final.[1][2]
